dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Altogether, the uplift for Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 was 2.53× and 1.70×, respectively.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: many bio results vs ASL-3/ASL-4 thresholds; chem/rad/nuc deferred to partners

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Based on the evaluation results, we believe the models do not demonstrate catastrophically risky capabilities in the cyber domain.
dc_eval_cyber.note: CTF scores per category, e.g. Web 12/15, Cybench 22/39

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Claude Opus 4 successfully passed an average of 16.6/42 problems, remaining below threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D / autonomy evals vs checkpoint and ASL-4 thresholds

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: attempts to hide dangerous capabilities, and attempts to manipulate users toward certain views
dc_eval_persuasion.note: manipulation named as a phenomenon the alignment assessment aims to detect; the audit dimension 'emotionally manipulative toward the auditor' is scored only in a figure (no numbers in text); 'Influence Operations' appears only as a refusal-test category; no persuasion capability result

dc_eval_scheming.quote: None of the snapshots we tested showed significant signs of sandbagging, or strategically hiding capabilities during evaluation.
dc_eval_scheming.note: also Apollo Research scheming/deception findings (4.1.1.4), self-exfiltration, subtle sabotage results

framework_threshold.quote: we have decided to release Claude Opus 4 under the ASL-3 Standard and Claude Sonnet 4 under the ASL-2 Standard.
framework_threshold.note: RSP; ASL-3 not ruled out, ASL-4 ruled out

ext_test_any.quote: Several of our external red-teaming partners reported that Claude Opus 4 performed qualitatively differently from any model they had previously tested.

ext_test_named_org.quote: we contracted with Apollo Research to assess an early snapshot for propensities and capabilities related to sabotage

ext_test_government.quote: joint pre-deployment testing of the new Claude Opus 4 model was conducted by the US AI Safety Institute (US AISI) and the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI)

safeguards_training.quote: To elicit helpful, honest, and harmless responses, we used a variety of techniques including human feedback, Constitutional AI

safeguards_runtime.quote: We implemented additional monitoring of harmful behavior
safeguards_runtime.note: also prompt-injection detection systems, ASL-3 safeguards blocking bio prompts

safeguards_access.note: account banning is post-hoc enforcement and Developer Mode opt-in is not risk-tied; no trusted-access/KYC/tiered restriction described

safeguards_weights.quote: we believe that our security is sufficient to prevent model self-exfiltration attempts by models of Claude Opus 4’s capability level
safeguards_weights.note: security against weight self-exfiltration; ASL-3 'security controls' (1.2.4)
